fields.summary: meta.current_phase / story.status never advance past their initial to-plan values — no CLI command or skill step transitions a story past 'planned' or moves meta.current_phase/entry_phase forward as phases complete (confirmed: all 6 roadmap stories for the docs-first/agent-agnostic initiative, including the already-gated playbook-authoring phase, still read status=planned and current_phase=playbook-authoring after cli-embed-scaffold's own gate). audit's unknown_phase drift check doesn't catch this since the slug is still a valid story. Out of cli-embed-scaffold's Allowed Surfaces (resume/story domain logic); needs its own scoping pass.
